body.name: \(\Delta_n^*(K;\eta_n)\)
body.construction: For every vanishing sequence \(\eta=(\eta_n)\) and each finite \(n\), set \(\Delta_n^*(K;\eta_n)=\sup_{P_n\in\mathcal M_n^{\mathrm{CY},0}}\delta_n(P_n;\eta_n)\), where \(\mathcal M_n^{\mathrm{CY},0}\) is the previously defined \(n\)-th slice of \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY},0}\).
